newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Cablecom gets most remaining Cortaillod shares.
newsitem.headline: Cablecom gets most remaining Cortaillod shares.

text.p: Swiss group Cablecom Holding AG said it had been offered most remaining outstanding shares in SECE Cortaillod Holding AG, extending Cablecom's controlling stake to 99.20 percent.
Cablecome said it was offered over 90 percent of the outstanding 257,506 SECE Cortaillod shares as of September 19.

Cablecom, a cable network operator held by state agency Swiss PTT and German groups Siemens and FBA, said in June it was buying Alcatel Alsthom's 75 percent stake in SECE Cortaillod or 813,446 shares for about two billion French francs.
It also bought smaller packets of 9,048 from a Swiss holding and Cortaillod pension fund and 16,772 shares from other company holdings.
Cablecom said the offer would be extended an obligatory 10 bourse days from September 26 though October 10 in accordance with Swiss bourse law.
